sources.title: Gemini 2.0 Flash Model Card, April 15, 2025
sources.evidence: Page 2 names this exact model and identifies the Gemini 2.0 series, including Flash, as using sparse Mixture-of-Experts Transformer architecture. It specifies multimodal input, a 1,048,576-token context, and text output. No total or active parameter counts are supplied. Freshly reopened on October 27, 2026: the seven-page card contains no numerical parameter specification. It describes improvements upon 1.5 Flash with refined architecture and optimization, not an unchanged named base whose size could be inherited.

sources.title: Introducing Gemini 2.0: our new AI model for the agentic era
sources.evidence: Dated December 11, 2024. Announces public Gemini 2.0 Flash Experimental access in the Gemini API, AI Studio, Vertex AI, and Gemini app. Describes fast multimodal input and native tool calls; broad developer availability initially has text output.

sources.title: Gemini 2.0: Flash, Flash-Lite and Pro
sources.evidence: February 5, 2025 announcement makes Gemini 2.0 Flash generally available with multimodal input, text output and native tool use. It separately identifies Gemini 2.0 Flash Thinking Experimental as a reasoning variant.

sources.title: Gemini 2.0 Flash — Gemini API model documentation
sources.evidence: Exact model-code entry lists audio/image/video/text input, text output, 1,048,576 input tokens, and function calling. It groups stable and experimental version identifiers and labels Thinking Experimental. Documents shutdown June 1, 2026; these are historical specifications, not evidence of an operating endpoint. Reopened during the parameter re-audit; the exact-model specification still supplies no total or active count.

sources.title: Gemini 2.5: Pushing the Frontier with Advanced Reasoning, Multimodality, Long Context, and Next Generation Agentic Capabilities
sources.evidence: The later Gemini 2.X report explicitly covers 2.0 Flash. Page 1 identifies standard 2.0 Flash as non-thinking; Table 1 includes experimental thinking/image capabilities with an asterisk. Section 2.5 distinguishes the experimental Flash Thinking model. The exact-model comparison table and parameter mentions supply no size or activation counts. Fresh full-report inspection found generic sparse-expert routing language and capability/throughput/pricing comparisons, but no total or activated-parameter column for Gemini 2.0 Flash. The distillation discussion does not identify a size-preserving named base for this model.

sources.title: Gemini 2.5 Flash and native capabilities — Model Card, December 2025 update
sources.evidence: The later comparison card explicitly evaluates gemini-2.0-flash and labels its column Non-thinking. Comparisons report capabilities and benchmarks, not 2.0 Flash total or active parameter counts. No 2.5 architecture or size was transferred to 2.0. Fresh full-card inspection again found no numerical model-size or per-token activation disclosure for the 2.0 Flash comparison entry.

sources.title: Gemini API Additional Terms of Service
sources.evidence: Hosted Gemini model access is governed by service terms that prohibit extraction or replication of the underlying model, including parameter weights. This supports the descriptive proprietary classification rather than a redistributable weight license.

sources.title: Gemini 2.0 Flash — Google Cloud model documentation (German)
sources.evidence: Exact model page lists application/pdf among document input MIME types, Thinking as unsupported, and function calls as supported. Dates gemini-2.0-flash-001 to February 5, 2025. Page updated July 30, 2026; its unrelated output-limit value conflicts with the model card and Gemini API page and is not adopted.

sources.title: Gemini API release notes
sources.evidence: Records public Gemini 2.0 Flash Experimental on December 11, 2024, distinct Flash Thinking Mode on December 19, 2024, and text-output gemini-2.0-flash-001 GA on February 5, 2025.

sources.title: Models.dev Gemini 2.0 Flash record
sources.evidence: Original catalog lead was inspected. Its values were checked against the developer sources rather than treated as independent technical verification.

sources.title: Gemini 3 Pro Model Card
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27 parameter re-audit checked the complete later model card and comparison material. Its parameter discussion describes generic sparse MoE routing, without a total or activated count for Gemini 2.0 Flash or a size-bearing lineage statement.

sources.title: Gemini 4 Argon Model Card
sources.evidence: Fresh complete model-card text was inspected after HTTP gzip decoding. No total or active parameter count for Gemini 2.0 Flash, and no explicit unchanged-base relationship supplying such a count, appears in the later card or its comparisons.

sources.title: Gemini 4 Safety Report
sources.evidence: Fresh complete report and later comparison tables were checked for model size and activated-parameter columns. Gemini 2.0 appears in discussion of monitoring history, without a count for 2.0 Flash. The report's parameter mentions concern evaluation difficulty, weight security, and knowledge encoded in weights; they do not disclose model size.

sources.title: Evaluating Planning Capabilities — third-party estimate lead
sources.evidence: Fresh exact-model search returned a Table 6.1 excerpt assigning Gemini 2.0 Flash approximately 20–30B estimated active parameters. Its own footnote explicitly labels the counts community estimates. Opening the full PDF returned HTTP 403, so the full document was not read. This search-result lead is neither a Google specification nor sufficient evidence to adopt a count.

name.note: Matches the official model name and undated API code.

developer.note: Developed by Google's Gemini/Google DeepMind team; retains the catalog's organization label.

family.note: Normalized catalog grouping for the official Gemini Flash lineage.

release_date.note: Earliest public release of the named model was experimental on December 11. The stable -001 API revision became generally available February 5, 2025; the December date does not assert GA availability.

open_weights.note: Official distribution is a hosted model service under restricted access terms; no downloadable weight release is identified in the reviewed developer materials.

license.note: Descriptive classification of the hosted model's terms; documentation and sample-code licenses do not license its weights.

parameters_b.note: Fresh exact-model total/active/lineage searches and reopened original Google evidence found no published total count. Full Gemini 2.X report and later Flash/Pro/Argon comparison checks found no nominal size disclosure. Similar speed, shared MoE family, and distillation discussion do not identify an unchanged named base with a published count; no size is inferred from them.

active_parameters_b.note: Rechecked independently of total parameters. Neither the exact card/API nor later first-party comparison tables disclose an activated-parameter number for Gemini 2.0 Flash. Generic sparse routing supplies no numerical count. The fresh 20–30B search lead explicitly calls its numbers community estimates and its full PDF was inaccessible; it is not adopted as a specification.

architecture.note: The exact model card explicitly includes Gemini 2.0 Flash in the sparse MoE Transformer description.

context_window.note: Exact published input context limit in tokens.

modalities.note: Standard API model supports text output and the listed inputs; PDF is a supported document format. Experimental image/audio and Live variants are outside this endpoint's output scope.

reasoning.note: Dedicated thinking flag is false for standard 2.0 Flash. Later first-party prose and comparison columns explicitly call it non-thinking. The API page's Experimental label and report's starred thinking capability encompass the separately released Flash Thinking variant. This does not deny ordinary reasoning ability.

tool_call.note: Native tool use and function calling are explicitly documented.

description.value: Gemini 2.0 model with multimodal input, text output and native tool use.
description.note: Describes documented inputs, output and tool capability without promotional workhorse wording.

patch.notes: Sparse MoE Transformer; total and active parameter counts are undisclosed. Release date is the public experimental debut; stable API GA followed February 5, 2025. Specifications describe standard text-output Flash, distinct from Flash Thinking and image-generation variants. Google documents shutdown on June 1, 2026.
patch.description: Gemini 2.0 model with multimodal input, text output and native tool use.

summary: October 27 parameter re-audit reopened the exact Gemini 2.0 Flash card/API and inspected the full Gemini 2.X report, later 2.5 Flash comparisons, Gemini 3 Pro card, Gemini 4 Argon card, and Gemini 4 safety report. Fresh exact-model total, active, and lineage searches found no developer-published numerical count or size-preserving named-base relationship. A 20–30B active-parameter search lead explicitly identifies community estimates and the full PDF returned 403. Both parameter fields remain undisclosed with explicit null patches. The other 12 field assessments and the previous non-parameter corrections are preserved.
